Implementation Plan Implementation plan for `orchestrator/project-2974` at `47249b5fdfe501fa07fd691e41fe5098f2f74be9` on `orchestrator/project-2974` (integration ref matches). ## Automation / wiring - Change type: extend existing scripts/workflows only; no new standalone script, no new supervisor. - Existing automatic entrypoints: - `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` (`workflow_dispatch`) for aggregation/reporting. - If source-side `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN` emission is added, reuse the existing review pipeline entrypoint rather than adding a new trigger. - Long-running supervisor: none. - DB / migration work: none. - `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`: no entry needed. ## Clarification interpretation - No Q1/Q2 existed. - `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` adds no extra requirements; proceed with the issue body as written. ## Conflicts / codebase notes - `scripts/cost_audit.py` is currently a standalone operator audit tool; the periodic analyst path is separate (`collect_workflow_logs.py` → `summarize_unselected_runs.py` → `analyze_workflow_logs.py` → `prompts/mode-workflow-analysis.txt`). So surfacing these columns in the periodic audit requires touching that path too, not only `cost_audit.py`. - `scripts/fixtures/cloudflare-learnings/phase-h-context-budget-overflow.txt` does not exist yet. - `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` still has 3 direct long-running `codex ... exec` loops; `scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh` already exists and is already used in other Codex callsites. - CI/release workflows explicitly enumerate standalone test files, so any new focused regression test must be wired into those lists or it will never run. ## Files likely to change Primary: - `scripts/cost_audit.py` - `scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py` - `scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py` - `scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py` - `prompts/mode-workflow-analysis.txt` - `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` Likely if source-side warning emission is required for accurate per-phase/model data: - `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh` - `scripts/review_consolidate.sh` - `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` - `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` - possibly `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` for threshold env wiring Tests / fixtures: - `scripts/fixtures/cloudflare-learnings/phase-h-context-budget-overflow.txt` [new] - one focused regression test, preferably following the existing standalone `cost_audit` test pattern - `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py` (fixture presence coverage) - `tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py` / `tests/test_analyze_workflow_logs.py` if new structured fields are threaded through the workflow-log-analysis pipeline - `tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py` or equivalent executed contract coverage for heartbeat wrapping - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml` - `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` ## Functions / modules to implement 1. **`scripts/cost_audit.py`** - Extend `parse_log()` to recognize: - `BREAK_GLASS:` - `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN:` - Add additive metrics: - `cache_hit_rate` - `wall_clock_p50_ms` - `wall_clock_p99_ms` - `break_glass_count` - `context_budget_warn_count` - Add model-catalog/context-window lookup using `scripts/codex_model_catalog.json`. - Keep the current JSON/markdown shape intact; only add fields/columns. 2. **Workflow-log-analysis reuse path** - Reuse the cost-audit parsing logic against already-fetched workflow data instead of adding a second GitHub fetch path. - Smallest safe path: - parse selected-run logs inside `collect_workflow_logs.py` - parse unselected-run logs while `summarize_unselected_runs.py` already has them - carry additive fields through `analyze_workflow_logs.py` - Alternative acceptable path: add an additive offline/report-input mode to `cost_audit.py` and call that from `workflow-log-analysis.yml`, but it must consume local collector output, not `gh`. 3. **Workflow-log-analysis surfacing** - Update the periodic analysis input so the new columns are visible to the analyzer/report, not just to standalone `cost_audit.py`. - Update the analyst prompt text so cache-hit rate, wall-clock percentiles, break-glass counts, and context-budget warnings are explicitly called out in the report/metrics appendix. 4. **Heartbeat wrapping** - Replace the 3 direct Codex invocations in `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml` with the existing `scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh` pattern. - Follow the existing wrapper usage from `scripts/review_consolidate.sh` / `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`: preserve stdout/stderr capture, exit codes, and retry behavior. 5. **`CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN` emission** - If offline reconstruction is insufficient, emit the standardized line at the prompt-producing review phases that already know prompt size/model. - Use the plan’s contract: - per-phase threshold - model-specific context window - default ratio `0.7` - optional absolute override via `MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS_FOR_PHASE` ## Data structures affected - `cost_audit_report.json` - per-run additive fields for the new metrics - per-workflow additive aggregate fields/columns - `workflow_log_report.json` - additive per-run cost/review telemetry so the periodic audit can reuse existing fetched data - `analysis_context.json` - additive run/aggregate fields so `workflow-log-analysis` can surface the same metrics - `log_summary` preservation path - ensure unselected runs do not lose `BREAK_GLASS` / `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN` signals ## API / interface changes - New stable log prefix: - `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN: phase=

prompt_tokens= model_context_window= ratio= threshold=` - New additive knobs: - `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN_RATIO` default `0.7` - optional `MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS_FOR_PHASE` - If `cost_audit.py` gets a workflow-log-analysis input mode, it must be additive and must not replace the current `gh`-backed operator mode. ## Risks / edge cases - `cache_hit_rate` denominator can be zero; must fail open to null/`N/A`, not divide by zero. - Existing OpenRouter usage lines allow `?`; new math must tolerate missing values. - Percentiles must stay in milliseconds everywhere. - Catalog misses / unknown model slugs must not crash parsing. - `analyze_workflow_logs.py` currently narrows run fields; if not updated, newly collected metrics will be silently dropped from the periodic report. - Unselected runs are only visible through `log_summary`; if that path does not preserve the new warning signals, periodic analysis will undercount them. - Heartbeat wrapping must not break the current empty-output retry logic in any of the 3 workflow-log-analysis Codex jobs. - Current logs do not obviously expose exact model metadata for every review subphase; if exact phase/model reconstruction is impossible offline, add the warning where the prompt is actually built rather than guessing later. ## Testing considerations - Add `scripts/fixtures/cloudflare-learnings/phase-h-context-budget-overflow.txt`. - Add one focused regression test using that fixture to prove: - `CONTEXT_BUDGET_WARN` is generated/parses correctly - new additive metrics land without breaking existing output shape - Extend fixture-presence coverage in `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`. - If structured fields are threaded through collector/analyzer, update `tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py` and/or `tests/test_analyze_workflow_logs.py`. - Add executed contract coverage for the workflow-log-analysis heartbeat wrapper. - Update explicit test invocations in `ci.yml`, `mark-stable.yml`, and `test-and-mark-stable.yml` if the regression lands as a new standalone test file. - Verify the workflow-log-analysis diff adds no new `gh` / `gh api` calls. ## Smallest safe implementation order 1. Extend `scripts/cost_audit.py` with the additive metrics/shared helpers. 2. Reuse that logic inside the existing workflow-log-analysis data path so no extra GitHub calls are introduced. 3. Surface the new fields in `analysis_context.json` and `prompts/mode-workflow-analysis.txt`. 4. Wrap the 3 workflow-log-analysis Codex steps with `scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh`. 5. Land the Phase H fixture + regression coverage and wire any new standalone test into the explicit workflow test lists. ## Assumptions - No additional human clarification is required beyond the issue body. - No `files_touched` list was provided, so the plan uses the smallest safe set implied by the current architecture. - Additive schema/interface changes are acceptable; renames/removals are not. ## Missing-context notes - I did not have a real sample `workflow_log_report.json` artifact from production, so the exact report rendering details will need to be matched during implementation against the current analyzer output.
